fusions.name: Matchbook Flick
fusions.desc: Strikes a match from the book and flicks it into the first enemy it meets for 7 damage, setting the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Burnt Offerings
fusions.desc: After a 0.8 second cast, burns 4 written offerings and sends them out at once, spread apart, each dealing 14 damage plus 4% of a boss or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Tinder Jacket
fusions.desc: Wraps you in flash sheets for 8 seconds. 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Catching Scraps
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, a burning scrap leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 8 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 4 seconds.
